responsibility: Centralizes target-specific option enums, feature-bit masks, and derived TARGET_* predicates for the RISC-V backend. It defines the ABI, code-model, ISA-spec, microarchitecture, multilib-selection, stack-protector, and extension-subset flag spaces, plus helper macros such as TARGET_MIN_VLEN and per-extension enable tests, providing the compile-time option vocabulary shared across the rest of the port.
